_what: The side sweep of OMEGA v0.16.0's re-extraction at contract 182.3.2, stage by stage: the answer of every stage_strategy_draft that measured a metric (418; kept from the probe's raw call logs). `sent` is the ENTRY axis every one of them staged, with <metric> the stage's metric as BOTH levels; the draft's report read the metric as a `value` column at the anchor. A warning on entry.levels.LONG ("sits below price by definition") marks the metric below, one on entry.levels.SHORT above, none neither: data/derived/entry_level_sides.json is derived from these answers and tests/test_reextraction_182.py replays them. The drafts, their discards and what the sweep is are in data/audit/reextraction_182_2026-11-20.json (drafts.S).
alsoStaged: the first stage of the second run carried the whole preset body, and the first stage of each batch of 30 the REPORT that reads the batch (`stagedAxes`); the first run staged one report reading all 418 levels before its 24 entries
at: the UTC instant read on the host just before the call
